discussions.name: Boulder
discussions.covers: Front Range, Summit County and the northern mountains
messages: Next storm system arrives today, bringing chances for light mountain snow through Saturday.
Gusty winds and elevated fire weather conditions this afternoon across most of the Front Range foothills and plains.
Cooler pattern emerges this weekend into next week.

discussions.name: Grand Junction
discussions.covers: the western and central mountains, Aspen to the San Juans
messages: Measurable snowfall is expected tonight into Saturday for the mountains, with some high valleys also seeing light accumulations.
Temperatures will trend downward for the weekend, with most desert valleys seeing their first freezing temperatures of the year.
Fast moving storms are possible through much of Thanksgiving week. Stay tuned for updates to timing and impacts as they become available.

discussions.name: Pueblo
discussions.covers: the southern mountains: Sangre de Cristos, eastern San Juans, Monarch
messages: Potential for high winds along the east slopes of the southern Sangre De Cristo mountains and western Huerfano county today, otherwise warm and windy for most of the lower elevations.
Windy with rounds of light mountain snows across the Continental Divide, spreading into the southeast mountains on Saturday.
Cooler Saturday with a few light showers possible across the southeast plains.
Below normal temperatures for Sunday into next week with fast moving systems bringing opportunities for light showers Monday and Thursday, mainly mountains.

report.message:
Happy Thursday!

No new snow overnight but our snowmaking crews have been at it refreshing our trails and the surface is looking great. Today you can expect mostly sunny skies with a high of 34 F. Winds will be coming from the south at 10 mph with gusts up to 25 mph.

Chance for snow tonight. In the meantime, get out there and enjoy making turns! Remember to always ski and ride in control, stay aware of those around you, and respect all posted signs, closures, and ropes.
